description: This file provides tenant encryption helper functions for backend parity, including deriving encryption keys from tenant salt configuration, and functions to encrypt and decrypt tenant IDs using AES-128-ECB with base64 encoding.

methods.name: deriveKeyFromSalt
methods.description: Derives a 16-byte encryption key from the tenant salt configuration by decoding a URL-safe base64 salt and hashing it with SHA-256.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID string using AES-128-ECB with the derived key and returns a base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted tenant ID (base64 string without padding) back to plaintext using AES-128-ECB with the derived key.
